annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, (EU) 2021/695, (EU) 2021/697, (EU) 2021/1153, (EU) 2023/1525 and 2024/795, as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, (EU) 2021/695, (EU) 2021/697, (EU) 2021/1153, (EU) 2023/1525 and 2024/795, as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal amending six EU funding regulations to channel EU budget resources into defence and dual-use technologies under the ReArm Europe Plan. It adds defence as a fourth STEP strategic sector, funds AI Gigafactories and drones among priorities, and adds funding flexibility; it contains no AI safety or robot governance rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds defence technologies as a fourth strategic sector in the STEP Regulation (EU) 2024/795.
Opens the EIC Accelerator to dual-use and defence applications, with an exception to Horizon Europe's civil-only principle.
Allows cumulation of funding and voluntary transfers of cohesion funds to the EDF and ASAP; extends ASAP to end-2026.
Adds AI Factories and Gigafactories as objectives in Digital Europe and CEF digital sector.
Lets Digital Europe restrict dual-use actions to EU-controlled entities; sets CEF military mobility co-financing up to 100%.
